title: File:RoRo ship Victory leader leaving Zeebrugge.jpg
art: For a gallery of some more of my uploaded pictures see:  here.
desc: RoRo ship Victory leader leaving the port of Zeebrugge, Belgium. Hold larboard by tugboat Smit Lion. The car carrier (IMO: 9395628) was built in 2010 in Vietnam and is registered in Nassau, Bahamas. Shipping line: NYK Line (Nippon Yusen Kaisha), Tokyo, Japan.
